implementation.contract: Validate actual API fields and complete lists, IDs, counts, month and optional alert coverage; do not coerce missing fields into zero
implementation.unsupportedAmounts: Credit remains unknown; unsupported potential, per-zone money and received percentage removed
implementation.scopes: Current registered clients/pools; monthly document balances; payments by received date; global preview lists and complete alert counts with per-source limit
implementation.readLifetime: Clear on new read, month change, error, offline, timeout and session change; generation plus fingerprint reject ignored-cancellation late responses
implementation.initialization: Lisbon initial month before shared navigation restoration; initial request after pageshow
implementation.auth: Common 401 logout retained; A-to-B-to-A storage transition locks page, including same-tab mutation checks
implementation.rendering: Text nodes and validated numeric navigation IDs; existing sections, document/client/alert links preserved
implementation.layout: Existing manual-state marker prevents shared adapter from collapsing the entire panel; responsive layout and scoped light/dark palette

validation.timeoutTest: The production 15000ms timer is accelerated to 40ms in the browser test; late response remains rejected after the UI times out.
adjustments: The 401 test was aligned with the existing central logout/navigation behavior rather than expecting the page to remain open.
Initial month assignment moved before DOMContentLoaded so navigation restoration is not overwritten.
Visual QA found shared state-adapter compression despite initial no-overflow assertions; manual marker and geometric checks were added.
Contrast is checked after theme transitions finish, using final rendered foreground/background colors.
